en.title: Exporting Financial Reports
en.excerpt: How organizers download Excel ledgers, revenue breakdown charts, and individual participant invoices for event financial auditing.
en.content:
Event Financial Summaries

Under Event Dashboard > Reports > Finance, organizers can inspect detailed income visualizers broken down by competition category, payment channel (QRIS, VA, Manual), and registration dates.

Excel & CSV Data Exports

Click Export to Excel to download a complete ledger containing:

  • Participant Name, Club, and Category.
  • Payment Gateway Reference & Transaction Timestamp.
  • Gross Amount, Processing Fees, and Net Settled Amount.

Batch Invoices & Receipts

Generate formal PDF payment receipts stamped with the tournament committee's digital seal for participants who require proof of payment for club or school reimbursements.
